title: R3D: Quantitative 3D Spatial Reasoning for Egocentric Wearables
abstract: arXiv:2607.02921v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantitative 3D spatial reasoning from egocentric RGB-D video is an important capability for next-generation wearable assistants. Yet existing benchmarks do not reflect the challenges of handling (1) natural egocentric video, (2) posed RGB-D video inputs, and (3) challenging quantitative 3D spatial reasoning Q&A. To fill this gap, we introduce R3D-Bench (Reasoning in 3D), a benchmark of 2,950 quantitative spatial reasoning questions across 15 types--spanning multiple-choice, distance-based, and volumetric reasoning questions--built on top of 57 egocentric video sequences from Aria Digital Twin. To set a strong baseline on this dataset, we introduce R3D, a model-agnostic spatial tool-calling framework. In contrast to existing approaches that directly embed 3D information into the model's input representation, R3D constructs a 3D scene from video using segmentation and depth-lifted object representations. translated_title: R3D：面向第一人称视角可穿戴设备的定量3D空间推理
translated_abstract: 从第一人称视角的RGB-D视频中进行定量3D空间推理是下一代可穿戴助手的一项重要能力。然而，现有的基准测试并未反映处理以下问题的挑战：（1）自然的第一人称视频，（2）带有位姿的RGB-D视频输入，以及（3）具有挑战性的定量3D空间推理问答。为填补这一空白，我们推出了R3D-Bench（Reasoning in 3D），这是一个包含2,950道定量空间推理问题的基准测试，涵盖15种类型——包括选择题、基于距离的推理问题和体积推理问题——构建于来自Aria Digital Twin的57个第一人称视频序列之上。为了在该数据集上建立强大的基线，我们提出了R3D，这是一个与模型无关的空间工具调用框架。与现有直接将3D信息嵌入模型输入表示的方法不同，R3D使用分割和深度提升的对象表示从视频中构建3D场景。它提供此信息……
tldr: 该论文提出了R3D-Bench——一个基于第一人称RGB-D视频、包含2,950道定量空间推理问题的基准测试，并引入了模型无关的空间工具调用框架R3D，通过分割和深度提升的对象表示构建3D场景来实现定量3D空间推理。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces R3D-Bench, a benchmark of 2,950 quantitative spatial reasoning questions built on egocentric RGB-D video, and R3D, a model-agnostic spatial tool-calling framework that constructs 3D scenes using segmentation and depth-lifted object representations for quantitative 3D spatial reasoning.
